claims: Alamo Brown is played by Adewale Akinnuoye-Agbaje.
Alamo Brown is introduced in Euphoria Season 3, Episode 1.
Alamo Brown is a crime boss.
Alamo Brown is a drug kingpin.
Alamo Brown forces Rue to balance an apple on her head while shooting it.
Rue made a fatal, laced drug delivery.
Alamo Brown tests Rue's loyalty and faith by shooting an apple off her head.
The apple scene occurs in the closing scene of Euphoria Season 3, Episode 1 premiere.
Alamo Brown tells Rue that "anyone can reinvent themselves."
